papers.title: Clinical event extraction with transformers
papers.text: We apply transformer encoders to clinical event extraction on the Demo Clinical Notes dataset. The model identifies event triggers in clinical notes.

papers.title: Prompt learning for clinical event extraction
papers.text: Prompt learning is applied to clinical event extraction using the Demo Clinical Notes dataset. The approach studies limited labeled examples.

papers.title: Clinical relation extraction with graph networks
papers.text: We use graph neural networks for clinical relation extraction on the Demo Relation Set. The graph represents entity dependencies.

papers.title: Transformer models for clinical relation extraction
papers.text: Transformer encoders are evaluated for clinical relation extraction on the Demo Relation Set. The study compares contextual representations.
